title: DLinear: Reported gains for DLinear do not survive covariate shift between train and test splits on ETTh1, Electricity
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using DLinear, a decomposition linear baseline. On ETTh1, Electricity, at horizon 336, Reported gains for DLinear do not survive covariate shift between train and test splits on ETTh1, Electricity. Held-out year-splits reduce DLinear advantage to within 1% MSE of the DLinear baseline. We discuss two limitations: Missing-value handling is delegated to preprocessing and not stress-tested. Comparison omits linear baselines that recent work has shown to be competitive. Future work should address reducing memory usage at input length ≥ 2048 without accuracy loss. and pretraining on a mixture of datasets to test transfer. [SEED-FIXTURE — not a real publication].
